applications.name: Meta conversion API
applications.description:
**The application is available for Growth, Professional and Enterprise Plan only**


This App allows you to improve the accuracy of the readings of your ads by understanding the actions people take on your store such as adding an item to a shopping cart or making a purchase


**Requirements**

To activate the Meta Pixel app [**here**](https://web.zid.sa/market/app/29)


**Integration Steps**


**1.** Go to Event Manager.

**2.** Click on the Datasheet view icon on the right top of the page.


**3.** Select The pixel ID you chose to associate with the Transformations API.

**4.** Click on SMTP. 


**5** Find API integration and click Complete Setup.



**Note**:

If you can't find the option of API integration,  it may be because the Transformations API integration is set up through the developer documentation and not the setup with instructions from the event manager.To set up Transformations API integration with Guided Setup, first create your own personalized instructions using the steps in Part One.


**6.** In the Transformations API, read the resources at learn More If you want to get additional information about the Transformations API before getting started.

**7.**  Click on verification codes. Copy your code.


**8.**  In the "Facebook Conversion API" application, paste the code in the "Your Account ID" field and press the activate button
applications.short_description: Improve and measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns for your store visitors on facebook and instagram

applications.name: Facebook Contact Us
applications.description:
**Turn website visitors into your next customers**

Let's make it easier for your customers to contact you with Facebook Contact Us. Most of your prospective customers are already using Facebook. It's time to give them the option to contact you in a way that feels familiar, trustworthy, and fun 


**Get back to your customers faster in a way they enjoy**

When someone has a question about your  business, chances are they’re just going to leave your site altogether rather than searching for a support email. With so many options out there, people are too busy to spend time looking for answers. But when you give them the option to easily contact you via Facebook right from your website, this feels like a quicker, more familiar way to get in touch. You can get back to them just a few hours later and they will get your reply directly to their mobile device. No more replies getting lost in an inbox with (probably) hundreds of emails.

Customers must have Facebook account in order to contact you


**Integration Steps**

**1.** Choose the right Plan for you

**2.** Activate the app from Zid App Market

**3.** Integration will be done directly

applications.name: Ersal
applications.description:
App Overview:

Ersal is a platform that helps you build communication and marketing with your customers via WhatsApp by integrating with your store. The available features do not require activation or verification from WhatsApp, as activation is instant and automatic.

Ersal Platform Features:

1- Notification Messages Service: Send order status updates, order confirmations, and notifications about new offers in your store automatically through your store’s WhatsApp number.

2- Notification Message Control: Send messages including the customer’s name, product type, purchase amount, and more.

3- Shipment Tracking Links: Automatically send shipment tracking links to the customer’s mobile once the shipping label is issued.

Additional Features (Available with Separate Subscription):

Broadcast Tools: Send bulk messages to hundreds of numbers daily, with guaranteed delivery even if the recipient hasn’t saved your number.
Auto Replies: Add dozens or hundreds of automated replies.
Export Tools: Export names, numbers, and other data to your device in Excel (xlsx), TXT, or CSV formats.
Scheduled Messages: Schedule broadcast messages in advance.
Automatic Incoming Number Categorization
Technical Support
applications.short_description: Manage all your messages across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok from a single platform.
